altText: A crude cartoon face with a candlestick chart drawn across its forehead. Green 'Buy' arrows point at the chart's peaks and red 'Sell' arrows point at its troughs, captioned 'So what have you learned so far?' with the answer being to buy high and sell low.

A black-and-white photo of an astronaut planting a Bitcoin flag on the moon beside a lunar module, with a bright yellow Lamborghini parked on the moon's surface. Large text reads 'When moon? When lambo?'

The two-panel Drake format. In the top panel he turns away in disgust from three red candles; in the bottom panel he points approvingly at three green candles, playing on red and green candlesticks in trading charts.
A man grimacing as he grips one arm with the other, straining to hold it back. Caption: 'Crypto investor trying to stop himself from checking crypto prices thousand times a day.'

A two-panel cartoon titled 'dinner with candles'. The top panel, marked with a red cross, shows a couple at a candlelit table. The bottom panel, marked with a green tick, shows a person happily eating alone in front of a laptop displaying green candlestick charts.
The Running Away Balloon format. A figure labelled 'Me' reaches for a balloon labelled 'Taking profits', then is held back by a pink figure labelled 'But it could 10x' as the balloon drifts away.

A four-panel comic. A woman smiles at her phone on a train while captions wonder whether she has received happy news or a message from a loved one. The final panel reveals her screen showing a BTC/USD chart of rising green candles.

A photograph of a person in a full astronaut suit and gold-visored helmet slumped asleep on a bare mattress on the floor of an empty room, surrounded by litter. Text reads 'When you invest everything in crypto'.

A screenshot of a tweet captioned 'Prayer of every trader #Cryptocrash', showing a baby with hands clasped and eyes closed as if praying, with a thought bubble containing a rising green candlestick chart.
The Shiba Inu dog from the Doge meme, its head attached to the nose of a rocket firing its engines as it launches away from Earth, surrounded by floating Dogecoin coins against a starfield.

A two-panel schematic drawing. The top panel, labelled how people think it is like to HODL, shows a cyclist on a flat road with a chequered finish flag ahead. The bottom panel, labelled what it is actually like, shows the same cyclist facing steep peaks, deep valleys, a water crossing, a tunnel and a rainstorm before the flag.
A smiling older man holding a mug beside a laptop showing a steeply rising green candlestick chart. Caption: 'A green candle a day keeps the doctor away.'
The engraved portrait of Benjamin Franklin from a US hundred-dollar bill on a black background, with his eyes replaced by two orange Bitcoin logos.
